description: D-PM-60 derived A2 stable KDA backward unit. Only the cumulative-gate cache and its four consumers retain FP32; other eight caches, five kernels, arithmetic order and synchronization match a2.kda_bwd_stable. Host work is allocation and metadata views. Hardware qualification is pending.

saved.note: The nine forward checkpoints, in this order: g_cumsum Aqk Akk w u qg kg v_new h. g_cumsum is the chunk-local cumulative gate in log2 space (natural-log cumsum divided by ln2). g_cumsum retains FP32; all other eight saved values retain BF16.

default.reason: Unchanged predecessor fixture/stage budget; historical rationale below does not qualify this new artifact. The a5.kda_bwd budget, taken as the starting point because the arithmetic is the same. A2 measurements are reported per case; the budget is not an A2 claim.

dk.reason: Unchanged predecessor fixture/stage budget; historical rationale below does not qualify this new artifact. a5.kda_bwd's relaxation, kept: rounding the log2 cumulative gate before exp2 moves multiplicative derivatives at deep decay.

dg.reason: Unchanged predecessor fixture/stage budget; historical rationale below does not qualify this new artifact. a5.kda_bwd's relaxation, kept: the BF16 cumulative-gate cache alone gives relative L2 0.115-0.183 against unrounded autograd at deep decay.

finalize_pair.qk_left.reason: Unchanged predecessor fixture/stage budget; historical rationale below does not qualify this new artifact. finalize_pair's four products are FP32 dot products over 64 terms whose operands still carry the un-cancelled pairwise decay: measured on a 910B3, the operands span 13 decades (|k_scaled| up to 1.8e+13) and the sums reach 3.3e+08, so the terms cancel catastrophically. The device and torch sum in different orders, so elements near a cancellation disagree by tens of BF16 ulp while the vector norm does not. Measured over four cases (C=1,2,3 and HV=1,2,4): the worst elementwise disagreement is 58 ulp, at most 0.41% of elements exceed 1 ulp, and the worst relative L2 is 1.06e-07 (qk_right; s_base 1.1e-11, t_beta 1.6e-10, qk_left 2.9e-09). The relative L2 bound of 1e-5 is therefore the real criterion here, two orders above the worst measurement; the elementwise rtol of 1.0 is kept only as a gross-error guard, about twice the worst observed relative deviation (58 ulp is 0.23 to 0.45 of the value). These checkpoints are only meaningful once multiplied by the matching row or column scale, which finalize_post does. The budget was set after seeing device results; the six outputs keep the a5.kda_bwd budgets unchanged, and finalize_pre's scalings needed no relaxation at all (0 ulp, relative L2 at most 3.7e-27).
